notes.title: Solarpunk Tactics Now Speaks Your Language. Thanks to Localipsum!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Solarpunks![/b][/p][p]We have some fantastic news to share with you today! As our community grows around the world, we want to make sure Solarpunk Tactics is accessible to as many players as possible. To that end, we’re thrilled to announce that [b]we've collaborated with the amazing team at[/b] [b]Localipsum[/b] to bring full localization to our Steam store page![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537627/9185b0e3dc85486b621b04ad729fba278d3efdc2.png"][/img][/p][p]From the very beginning, our experience working with the Localipsum translation team was incredible. We believe that good localization is about more than just translating words; it’s about translating the [i]feeling[/i] and intent of the world.[/p][p]That’s why we kicked things off with an innovative call, bringing their translators together with our design and narrative leads. We had a deep conversation about the game's lore, its unique aesthetics, and the specific nuances of the [b]Solarpunk genre[/b]. This allowed the Localipsum team to grasp the core of Solarpunk Tactics and ensure every translation would be as accurate and immersive as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537627/f3d6954072d81ebca6327f593f06222eb4f17310.png"][/img][/p][p]Beyond that initial deep dive, the entire workflow was seamless. The setup was easy, the turnaround times were great, and the quality speaks for itself. We've already received wonderful feedback from community members in [b]Japan and Brazil[/b] on the accuracy and natural feel of the language on the store page, which is the best validation we could ask for![/p][p]This successful collaboration on our store page is just the first step. Based on this wonderful experience, we are hopeful that we can continue our partnership with Localipsum to bring a [b]full in-game localization[/b] of [b]Solarpunk Tactics[/b] to you in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537627/aab37caa408054dc661261b7c7e03c8bb34c2112.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Drop in our [url="https://discord.gg/UctBXeUGKe"][b]Discord Channel[/b][/url] and let us know what you think and which languages you're most excited to see![/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested in how Localipsum can help your game go global, check out [url="https://localipsum.com/gaming"]localipsum.com/gaming[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible support.[/p][p][b]The Solarpunk Tactics Dev Team[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Solarpunk Tactics Kickstarter pre-launch is live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537627/aa00e96d805a67859a6cf081c399748fe914deb8.png"][/img][/p][p]We've opened our Kickstarter Pre-launch page. We invite everyone to visit and click the "[b]Notify me on launch[/b]" button, so we can be in touch when the campaign launches![/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/obnoxgames/solarpunk-tactics"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/obnoxgames/solarpunk-tactics[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Why [b]Kickstarter[/b]?[/p][p]We believe the future depends on our ability to [b]build communities that know how to cooperate and create together[/b]. That means learning to grow things that last: bonds, games and ecosystems. In other words, we’re going to need more than clever mechanics. We’re going to need [b]sustainable [/b]ones.[/p][p]That kind of collaboration takes practice, so we’re starting now. Our first milestone is simple: to properly [b]credit and reward the human artists[/b] who make this world visible, audible, and emotional so players can truly [i][b]feel[/b][/i] the branching timelines ahead. As a visionary said: [i][b]“If the artists can’t find the way, then the way cannot be found.”[/b][/i][/p][p]We’re honored to be stewards of this project, but the future of [b]Lumnia[/b] will be shaped by the players. The most important [b]Solarpunk[/b] [b]Tactic [/b]isn’t a card or a combo, it’s [b]growing a community that[/b] [b]cares for each other[/b] and the world we’re building together. If that sounds like your kind of game, [b]we’d love your support.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely, from the team at[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537627/e140e726a8d1d6d915cf8bcec8c4b2a662c53885.png"][/img][/p]
